zh: 九类记录卡共用一套关联选择器：按标题搜索、按类型筛选、勾选与移除关联，已归档与回收站来源分别标注，读取失败保留关联并给出重试。新增 `widget-board:records.open` 能力与看板内的记录详情浮层，可查看前向关联与反向引用、逐级返回并恢复原滚动与表单输入；目标记录不必先有卡片。查询支持 `offset` 与 `nextOffset` 分批读取和按 `references` 查反向引用，只按前向引用现算、不双写；事务记录也能关联，运行时向用户组件公开 `widget.createRecordRelations`。
en: All nine record cards now share one relation picker: search by title, filter by kind, select and remove links, mark archived and trashed sources separately, and keep links with a visible retry when reading fails. A new `widget-board:records.open` capability and an in-board record detail overlay show outgoing links and incoming references, navigate back step by step and restore scroll and unsaved form input; the target record does not need a card. Queries accept `offset` and `nextOffset` for paged reads and `references` for incoming links computed from forward links without double writes; chores can link records too, and the runtime exposes `widget.createRecordRelations` to user widgets.
